description:
**WE'RE HIRING \\| LEAD ENGINEER – AI \\& PRODUCT ENGINEERING** 




  





 Location: Kolkata
 



 Company: Trafasa
 



 Experience: Ideally 5–10 years
 



 Compensation: ₹15–18 LPA, depending on capability and fit
 



 Role Type: Full\\-time \\| Hands\\-on \\| Early\\-stage / 0→1 Product Building
 



  





**ABOUT TRAFASA** 




  





 Trafasa is an early\\-stage technology company building an AI\\-enabled enterprise procurement and commerce platform.
 



 We are looking for an exceptional hands\\-on technology professional who wants to do more than maintain an existing product.
 



 You will help BUILD the product.
 



  





 This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys turning business problems into working software, wants significant technology ownership, and is excited by the possibility of growing with the company as our product, customers and engineering organisation scale.
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 We are looking for a Lead Engineer – AI \\& Product Engineering who can work closely with the founders and take hands\\-on ownership of product engineering and technology execution.
 



 This is NOT a pure people\\-management, project\\-management or enterprise\\-architecture position.
 



 You should still enjoy writing code, building prototypes, designing systems, integrating APIs, deploying applications and solving difficult production problems yourself.
 



 Initially, the engineering team will be small. We therefore need someone comfortable moving between architecture and implementation rather than depending on large specialised teams.
 



 As Trafasa grows, the role can evolve into broader engineering and technology leadership.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




  





 • Work closely with the founders to translate business requirements into product and technology solutions.
 



 • Architect and personally contribute to the development of Trafasa's core platform.
 



 • Build scalable backend services, APIs, workflows, integrations and data models.
 



 • Design and implement AI\\-enabled product capabilities using LLMs where they create genuine business value.
 



 • Build capabilities involving RAG, enterprise search, document intelligence, workflow automation and AI agents where appropriate.
 



 • Integrate external enterprise systems, APIs and third\\-party services.
 



 • Make pragmatic architecture decisions appropriate for an early\\-stage product — balancing speed, scalability, security and maintainability.
 



 • Own or actively participate in cloud deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, debugging and production troubleshooting.
 



 • Establish sensible engineering standards for code quality, security, testing, documentation and releases.
 



 • Conduct code/design reviews and mentor engineers as the team expands.
 



 • Help recruit and develop the future engineering team.
 



 • Gradually take broader ownership of engineering execution as Trafasa scales.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




  






 CORE ENGINEERING
 




  





 • Strong hands\\-on backend/software engineering experience.
 



 • Strong proficiency in at least one major backend stack such as Python, Java/Spring Boot, Node.js/TypeScript or equivalent.
 



 • Solid understanding of REST APIs, databases, authentication, distributed applications and system integration.
 



 • Experience designing and delivering production applications, not just prototypes or proofs of concept.
 



 • Strong SQL/database fundamentals; experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases preferred.
 



  






 AI / GENAI
 




  





 We do NOT expect someone who merely knows how to call an LLM API.
 



 We are looking for practical understanding of areas such as:
 



 • LLM application development
 



 • RAG and vector/semantic retrieval
 



 • Embeddings and document processing
 



 • Prompt/context engineering
 



 • Structured LLM outputs and tool/function calling
 



 • Agentic workflows
 



 • Evaluation, hallucination/grounding and guardrails
 



 • Human\\-in\\-the\\-loop workflows
 



 • AI observability and cost/latency considerations
 



  





 Hands\\-on exposure to frameworks/platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI or equivalent is useful — but demonstrated engineering ability matters more than a list of tools.
 



  






 CLOUD \\& DEVOPS
 




  





 Practical experience with:
 



  





 • AWS / Azure / GCP
 



 • Docker
 



 • CI/CD
 



 • Git
 



 • Cloud deployment
 



 • Logging and monitoring
 



  





 Kubernetes experience is useful but not mandatory.
 



  






 THE PERSON WE WANT
 




  





 Technology skills alone are not enough.
 



  





 You should be someone who:
 



  





 • Is still genuinely hands\\-on and enjoys building.
 



 • Can take an ambiguous business problem and convert it into a working product.
 



 • Is comfortable operating without a large engineering organisation around you.
 



 • Thinks like a product builder, not merely a task executor.
 



 • Can make sensible trade\\-offs instead of over\\-engineering everything.
 



 • Takes ownership when something breaks.
 



 • Can communicate technology decisions clearly to non\\-technical founders and business stakeholders.
 



 • Is curious about AI but understands that not every problem requires AI.
 



 • Wants to build systems that customers actually use.
 



 • Has the potential and ambition to grow into broader engineering leadership as the company scales.
 



  






 WHAT WE DO NOT NEED
 




  





 This role may NOT be suitable if:
 



  





 • You are currently looking only for a people\\-management role.
 



 • You have moved completely away from hands\\-on engineering.
 



 • Your experience is primarily project/program management.
 



 • Your AI experience is predominantly theoretical, managerial or presentation/strategy based.
 



 • You require a large engineering team before you can execute.
 



 • You prefer highly structured environments with narrowly defined responsibilities.
 



  





 WHY THIS ROLE MAY BE INTERESTING
 



  





 This isn't a role where you inherit a mature product and maintain somebody else's technology decisions.
 



  





 You will have an opportunity to influence what gets built, how it gets built and how the technology organisation evolves.
 



  





 For the right person, this can grow beyond a Lead Engineer position into significant engineering and technology leadership as Trafasa grows.
 



  





 You will work directly with the founders, have visibility into business and product decisions, and see the impact of what you build.
 



  





 LOCATION
 



  





 Kolkata.
 



  





 Candidates currently outside Kolkata may also apply if they are genuinely open to relocating.
 



  





 COMPENSATION
 



  





 ₹18–20 LPA, depending on experience, capability and overall fit.
 



  





 We prefer to be transparent about the range upfront so that both sides can determine fit before investing significant time in the interview process.
 



  





 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 



  





 Our selection process will focus less on certifications and job titles and more on what you have actually built.
 



  





 Be prepared to discuss:
 



  





 • A production system you personally designed and built
 



 • The specific code/components you personally implemented
 



 • Architecture decisions and trade\\-offs you made
 



 • A difficult production problem you personally debugged
 



 • A real AI/LLM/RAG implementation, if applicable
 



 • What you would build yourself during Trafasa's first few months
 



  





 We may also use a practical architecture/coding discussion rather than relying entirely on conventional interview questions.
 



  





**TO APPLY** 




  





 Please send your CV along with short answers to the following:
 



  





 5\\. Are you comfortable joining an early\\-stage company where you may initially need to architect, code, troubleshoot and deploy yourself?
 



  





 6\\. Are you based in Kolkata? If not, are you willing to relocate?
 



  





 7\\. What is your current CTC, expected CTC and notice period / earliest joining date?
 



  





 Please apply only if the hands\\-on nature, location and compensation range are broadly aligned with what you are looking for.
 



 We would rather have a small number of highly relevant conversations than a large number of generic applications.

description:
**Location:** 
 Ghatkopar West, Mumbai
   

**Work Model:** 
 Hybrid (4 Days Work From Office \\+ 2 Days Work From Home)
   

**Work Schedule:** 
 Monday to Saturday
   

**Shift Timings:** 
 10:00 AM \\- 7:00 PM IST
   

**Salary:** 
 Rs.30,000 \\- Rs.38,000 Per Month
   

  

  

**About Datastraw**
 Datastraw Technologies is an AI Ops company helping businesses transform their operations into AI\\-first operations. We build the systems, infrastructure and intelligence that enable businesses to automate, optimise and scale how work gets done.
   

  

 We’re building the infrastructure behind customer experience for modern consumer brands \\- bringing together customer conversations, workflows, knowledge, automation and AI to make CX operations more intelligent, efficient and scalable. We’re now building the technology layer that powers this.
   

  

 Our internal platform brings together customer conversations, brand knowledge, workflows, AI\\-assisted responses, operational data and third\\-party systems into one place. The goal is to make CX teams significantly more efficient while giving brands better visibility and control over their customer experience.
   

  

 We’re still early in this journey \\- which means there is a lot to build.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a Tech Lead who wants to take ownership of building and scaling Datastraw’s technology function.
   

  

 This is not a role where you’ll inherit a large engineering team and an established architecture.
   

  

 We have an early\\-stage product, a working internal CRM, process automations and several integrations already in place. What we need now is someone who can bring engineering discipline and structure to what we’ve built, continue building the platform, and gradually build a strong technology team around it.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with the founders, operations team and CX teams to understand real customer and business problems and turn them into technology solutions.
   

  

 You will be expected to be hands\\-on technically while also taking increasing ownership of architecture, engineering processes, technical decisions and team development.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
**1\\.** 
**Build \\& Scale the CX Platform**
* Take ownership of the architecture and continued development of our internal CRM and CX platform.
* Build new product capabilities across customer conversations, agent workflows, automation, reporting and AI.
* Design reliable systems that can support multiple brands, teams and workflows.
* Improve the existing platform rather than constantly rebuilding from scratch.
* Identify technical debt and progressively improve code quality, reliability and maintainability.


**2\\.** 
**AI \\+ Customer Experience**
 AI is a core part of where we are taking Datastraw. You’ll work on applying AI to real CX problems \\- not just building generic AI features.
   

  

**This could include:**
* AI\\-assisted customer response generation
* Brand/SOP/knowledge\\-base retrieval
* Agent copilots
* AI\\-based conversation analysis
* Automated escalation and routing
* AI voice and chat experiences
* Customer intent and sentiment understanding
* Workflow automation
* Evaluation and monitoring of AI responses
* Building systems that combine human agents with AI


 We’re particularly interested in someone who is genuinely curious about how AI can change customer experience operations.
   

  

**3\\.** 
**Integrations \\& Infrastructure**
 Our platform connects with multiple systems across the CX ecosystem.
   

  

**You’ll work with integrations such as:**
* WhatsApp and messaging platforms
* Email/ticketing systems
* Shopify Admin API
* Meta WhatsApp API
* Instagram Graph API


**You’ll also work across:**
* React
* Supabase
* PostgreSQL
* Supabase Auth
* Edge Functions / RPCs
* Webhooks
* Qdrant
* OpenRouter
* DeepInfra
* LLM and AI APIs


**You do not need to have worked with every technology listed above.**
 What matters is that you have strong engineering fundamentals and can understand, evaluate and work across a modern product stack.
   

  

**4\\.** 
**Bring Structure to Engineering**
 We are intentionally looking for someone who enjoys creating structure where there currently isn't enough of it.
   

  

**You'll help establish:**
* Development workflows
* Git and branching practices
* Code review processes
* Documentation
* Testing standards
* Deployment processes
* Monitoring and logging
* Security and access controls
* Technical documentation
* Product/engineering prioritisation
* Incident management
* Technical planning and estimation


 The expectation is not to introduce process for the sake of process.
   

  

 The expectation is to build simple systems that allow a small team to move quickly without things breaking.
   

  

**5\\. Build \\& Grow the Tech Team**
 As Datastraw's technology function grows, you’ll play an important role in building the team.
   

  

**You will:**
* Help define who we need to hire and when.
* Interview and evaluate technical candidates.
* Mentor junior engineers and interns.
* Establish expectations around engineering quality and ownership.
* Delegate effectively while remaining close enough to the technology to make good decisions.
* Help create a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous learning.


**6\\. Technology Strategy \\& Cost Ownership**
* Own Datastraw’s technology roadmap and help translate business priorities into technical priorities.
* Help manage the technology budget, including infrastructure, APIs, AI/LLM usage, third\\-party tools and other technology costs.
* Be accountable for ensuring our technology stack is cost\\-efficient, scalable and fit for purpose.
* Regularly evaluate technology vendors, infrastructure and tools to identify opportunities to optimise costs without compromising reliability or product quality.
* Make thoughtful build\\-vs\\-buy decisions and establish appropriate guardrails around technology and AI spend.
* Track technology costs as the platform and customer base scale, and proactively flag areas of increasing or unnecessary spend.


**What We’re Looking For**
 You could be a strong fit if you:
   

  

* **Have 2\\-5 years** 
 of professional software engineering experience.
* Have worked as part of a product or engineering team before.
* Have experience taking ownership of features or systems from idea → development → deployment.
* Are comfortable working in an early\\-stage or fast\\-changing environment.
* Have strong backend and API fundamentals.

* Have experience with React and modern web application development.
* Have worked with PostgreSQL or a similar relational database.
* Have experience with cloud\\-based platforms such as Supabase, AWS, GCP, Azure or similar.

* Can make sensible technical trade\\-offs rather than over\\-engineering everything.
* Are comfortable reading existing code and improving it.
* Can communicate technical concepts clearly to non\\-technical stakeholders.
* Enjoy mentoring and helping other engineers grow.

* Is primarily interested in people management and no longer wants to code.
* Wants every technical decision to already be made for them.
* Equates good engineering with building complex systems.

**We need someone who can look at an imperfect system and think: “I can make this better.”**

* Start establishing a repeatable engineering process.
* Identify the first key technology hires.


**3\\-6 Months**

* Build and mentor the initial engineering team.
* Improve scalability, observability and security.
* Develop a clear architecture for Datastraw's AI \\+ CX platform.
